notes.title: Dirty Blood Will Be Free!
notes.notes: Dirty Blood Is Going To Be Free Next Weak! The Reason Behind This Decision Is We Want Everyone To Play The Game, If It Locked Behind Paywall Many People Won't Be Able To Experience The Game! For The Existing Players Who Already Bought The Game You Guys Will Still Have The Game as It Is (We Will Not Give Refunds!)  We Hope This Is Wonderful Announcement To You Guys! And See You Soon

notes.title: v4.0 Green Update Bug Made A Big Issue!
notes.notes: After The Released Of The New Update (v4.0 "Green Update") Some Players Can't Play The Game Due To The Frozen Loading Screen, The Bug Came From Something Unknown In Green Village Map, We Don't Know How Or Where But We Are Working On That, We Decided To Go Back To v3.1 Temporarily, When Green Update Release Again? Well We Don't Know Yet But It Going To Be Very Soon!
